headline: Pinball's cabinet gets dangerous: orbit wrap, a grabbing magnet, and a DMD that talks back
lede: Rung 3 lands on PINBALL's CABINET ONE: hug the new left rail and the ball wraps the whole dome for 100 x MULT, three wraps light the ORBIT SET, and the descent chains straight into the firelane lock. A magnet post right of the dome grabs passing balls, holds them about two seconds while the clock keeps running, and pays to release them. Above the playfield a 30-glyph dot-matrix strip now narrates the table in its own glyphs — RAMP!, LOCK!, MULT x2. Meanwhile the nightly went green again: the quarantine PR landed, both red checks have owner issues with fixes already on main, and the refresh run carried the proof line.

notes.text: PINBALL rung 3 shipped (#3202): orbit wrap, magnet post, DMD insert — re-driven end-to-end in headless Chrome before landing (97/97 sim checks, 14/14 live-drive checks).

Red main cleared and proven: quarantine merged as 8e0c2af, refresh nightly 45511734081 SUCCESS with both QUARANTINED lines on the record; the FLOORBOSS pin's real fix (#3209) and zeldaplay's probe fix (#3211) are already on main, and the quarantine file is empty again.

The held queue drained while the freeze lifted: SKYWARD thunderpass juice, R-TYPE solo-wing throat logic, ICE CLIMBER DOWN-as-a-verb, TIDAL RUSH rain + moored sloops, MARBLE RUSH stage-2 sparks, and ball-to-ball collision in pinball.

One harness wrinkle for the record: cancelling a nightly flips main-ok to 'cancelled = ok', so the freeze lifted before the proof run finished — the proof arrived anyway, but a cancelled run is a weak gate (#601 territory).
